tasks.label: Update and upgrade Homebrew, npm
tasks.command: brew update && brew upgrade --yes && npm update -g

tasks.label: Install skills to all agents
tasks.detail: Install every .agents/skills/<name>/ dir globally via npx skills (copies to ~/.agents/skills/, symlinks to ~/.claude/skills/)
tasks.command: npx --yes skills add ./.agents/skills --agent claude-code --agent opencode --agent codex --global --yes

tasks.label: Update skills from remote sources
tasks.detail: Re-fetch all skills tracked in skills-lock.json from their remote sources and re-copy if changed

tasks.label: OKF AI-engineering: regenerate index
tasks.detail: Regenerate index.md for the ai-engineering OKF bundle from concept frontmatter

tasks.label: OKF AI-engineering: install skill
tasks.detail: Install only the okf-ai-engineering skill globally via npx skills (copies to ~/.agents/skills/, symlinks to ~/.claude/skills/)
tasks.command: npx --yes skills add ./.agents/skills/okf-ai-engineering --agent claude-code --agent opencode --agent codex --global --yes

tasks.label: OKF AI-engineering: regenerate index & install skill
OKF AI-engineering: build site
tasks.detail: Regenerate okf-site.html for the ai-engineering OKF bundle

tasks.label: OKF AI-engineering: open site
tasks.detail: Open the generated ai-engineering OKF site in the browser

tasks.label: OKF AI-engineering: build & open site
tasks.detail: Build and then open the ai-engineering OKF site

tasks.label: OKF AI-engineering: regenerate index, install skill, build and open site
tasks.detail: Regenerate the index, install the skill, build and open the site (runs all three in sequence)
dependsOn: OKF AI-engineering: regenerate index & install skill
